metadata.name: GetBranchDetails
metadata.description: Use this API to get Branch Details by providing Branch code.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: BranchCode
request_fields.description: Code assigned to branch from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:C1006 Note: It will required for get Branch Detail

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: Addressline1
children.description: Address Line 1 of the Branch Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point

children.name: Addressline2
children.description: Address Line 2 of the Branch Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way

children.name: City
children.description: City of Branch Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross

children.name: State
children.description: State of Branch Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Note : This should be restricted only with 2 characters.

children.name: Country
children.description: Two Character Country Code Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Refer Appendix section : Country Code Values

children.name: Postalcode
children.description: Postal Code of Branch Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093

children.name: InstitutionID
children.description: Institution ID of product. Valid Values:0-9 Example : 1230

children.name: ParentBranchID
children.description: Parent branch ID Valid values - 0-9 Example: 5727

children.name: BranchID
children.description: Branch ID Valid values: 0-9 Example: 1001

children.name: ParentBranchName
children.description: Parent branch name Valid Values - A-Z, a-z Example: CC Parent Branch Name

children.name: BranchName
children.description: Branch name Valid values:- A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : Georgia Branch

children.name: ParentBranchCode
children.description: Code of the parent branch. Valid values :A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 0895

children.name: BranchCode
children.description: Code assigned to branch from where the card was issued. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example:C1006

children.name: BranchStatus
children.description: whether the branch is Open or close Valid value 1 to 5 1 - Opened 2 - InActive 3 - Deleted 4 - Closed 5 - Moved Example : 1

children.name: BranchLocation
children.description: Location of the branch. Valid values : A-Z, a-z Example: Houston

children.name: CustomerReceiptInfo
children.description: Customer Receipt of the branch. Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 ,HTML tag Example:  Hi CustomerName This is Branch Receipt.

children.name: BankInformation
children.description: Bank information of the branch. Valid Value:- 1 - Add Bank Information 2 - Use Branch Parent Bank Example: 1

children.name: AdvanceCollectionACHPayroll
children.description: Advance collection of salary from customers through ACH payroll. Valid Value:- 1-Yes, 0-No Example:- 1

children.name: ImmediatePostACH
children.description: Flag to indicate the posting of Future dated ACH Transaction will be done on the effective date. Valid Value:- 1-Not Allowed, 2-All Credits and 3-Credits-Payroll Example:- 1

children.name: ContactName
children.description: Contact name of the person from the Branch. Field is Unicode Supported Valid Values: A-Z,a-z. Example: TestName

children.name: OfficePhoneNumber
children.description: Office phone number of the branch Valid values are 0-9 Example : 79747955668

children.name: MobilePhoneNumber
children.description: Mobile Phone Number of contact person of branch Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 9876543210

children.name: FaxNumber
children.description: FAX number of branch Valid values are 0-9 Example:9632581470

children.name: EmailAddress
children.description: E Mail Address of Branch Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: [email protected]

children.name: BankName
children.description: Name of the bank Valid values are A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example : BANCFIRST , Bank of America

children.name: BankAccountOwner
children.description: Bank Account Owner's name Valid values : A-Z, a-z Example: Daniel Ross

children.name: AccountType
children.description: Type of Bank account. Valid vales 0,1 or 2 0 - Checking 1 - Savings 2 - General Ledger Example: 1

children.name: ABANumber
children.description: Destination Routing and Transit number of institutions. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 623852453

children.name: BankAccountNumber
children.description: Bank Account Number Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1122345678

children.name: ProductID
children.description: ID of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9 Example: 1739,1758

children.name: ProductName
children.description: Name of the Account's Product Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Example: Cash card

children.name: PlasticCode
children.description: Plastic Code Valid values:0-9 Example: 32

children.name: PlasticCodeName
children.description: Plastic code used in product plastic mapping. Example: Access Card/Valid(32),Red(002)

children.name: ServiceFee
children.description: Fee that should be charged while card creation for plastic which is based on product setup. Valid values 0-9 Example: 55.69

children.name: ServiceFeeLoad
children.description: Service Load fee to be charged Valid values 0-9 Example: 23.36
